items.title: Fancy Fashion
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The fancy dance party is here! Are you feeling fancy? Fancy Fashion is perfect for anyone that wants to look fancy or fashionable. These cute outfits are perfect to impress your friends!

+ Fancy skins
+ Cute outfits
+ Fashion

By: Matif

items.title: Wildfire
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description:
Ignite your passion for Minecraft with these sizzling skins. Ready to equip! Terrorize your foes and delight your friends!
- Phoenix
- Kelvin
- Flamebow
- Endotherm
- Exotherm

items.title: Millionaire's Villa and Bunker
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description: Who has never wanted to live like a millionaire? Discover your new mansion and enjoy your new life in your villa and bunker! Search your house and find the hidden records so you can party with your friends!

items.title: Space Dropper
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Play Space Dropper, the all-time favorite arcade game! Drop through space in 10 different galactic levels and zigzag between planets and comets. Play alone or beat your friends in this fun and challenging arcade game! 

+ 10 Dropper arcade levels in your favorite galaxy
+ Single player and multiplayer
+ Custom sounds
+ Free skins
+ And more!

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Sky Mobs Nether Edition
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for some exciting skyblock adventures? Careful though, these nether creatures are crazy!
* Skins included!
* Perfect for any level Minecrafter!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Superhero Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Live your dream life of being everyone's favourite hero while saving the city of any danger! Choose between 12 overpowered armoured suits that will keep up your modern looks, but will also keep you safe from sneaky ninjas, monsters, and even hackers. Will you save the day?

- 12 skins
- Great for roleplay and adventure

items.title: Black and Yellow
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Black and yellow! Black and yellow! Black and yellow! Baby, you know what it is!
- 12 roleplay skins!
- Modern attire inspired by the colors black and yellow!

items.title: Obsidian Armor
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Check out these awesome obsidian inspired armor skins! They won't make you as strong as that obsidian block, but who cares you will certainly appear strong and cool. Armor is your skin style of choice. Be a pro on any skyblock game and crush some noobs on bed wars while you're at it!

- 12 awesome armor skins
- Modern designs for teens
- Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Cats Vs Dogs
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Are you a cat lover or a dog lover? With this skin pack, it doesn't matter! Represent your favorite animal or breed in this modern pack. With a variety of breeds and colors, this pack gives you great options to be your favorite feline or canine.

- 12 cat and dog skins
- Perfect for teens
- Fun modern designs
- Great for roleplay

items.title: Parkour Tornado
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Parkour Tornado is where you can test your jumping skills. Tour all the amazing levels and see if you can make it to the top!

- Difficulty progresses as you get higher

By 4KS Studios

items.title: Insects & Bugs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Buzzzzz! Roleplay as your favorite creepy-crawlies with this inspect-inspired skin pack!

- Six hand-crafted bug skins
- One skin free
- By 57Digital

items.title: Furry Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Showcase your fun personality with this adorable skin pack!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Includes a FREE skin! You deserve it.
- By 57Digital

items.title: Skyscrapers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Appreciate these monumental skyscrapers with this architecture-inspired skin pack!

- Six hand-crafted HD building skins!
- By 57Digital

items.title: GAMER MOBS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These pro gamers are Minecraft mobs! Look like a pro gamer with these epic mob gamer skins.

+ Includes 10 gamer mob skins
+ Great for PvP, PvE, and role-playing


GAMER MOBS by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Mob Cuties
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Mob Cuties are perfect for any Minecraft player! Want to look like a cute mob? Choose any of these cute mob skins and show them off to your friends!

- Cute mob skins
- Modern mob clothing styles

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Secret Treehouse Base
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Live in this secret treehouse base and make it your own! In your treehouse you will find:

- Custom furniture models (325+ variations!)
- Security cameras and lasers
- Villager spawner
- Automatic farms
- Mega chest rooms
- Rotating wardrobe

and much more!
items.changelog:
Changes to the new update:
- Updated map and build to 1.20
- 325+ furniture model variations added
- Multiple villages and mines to explore in the world
- Redesigned interior with custom furniture models
and much more!

items.title: Rich Gang
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Gang gang baby! We lookin' fresh as ever! Stacked up and blinged out! Let's get that paper!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Casual modern attire inspired by rich fashion!

items.title: Mermaid Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as a mermaid! Half fish, half human, full magical!

+ 10 mermaid themed teen skins!
+ Roleplay ready!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Anime School
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Straight out of anime, these teen skins are ready to hang out with their friends all day at school! With the 'Anime School' skin set there is a wide variety of skins and fancy uniforms to choose from. Find one to perfectly suit you!

- 8 anime school skins!
- Different school uniform designs and patterns!
- Skirts, suits, ties, and unique hairstyles!

items.title: Monochromatic Spirals
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: The most elegant of spirals is beyond a doubt the fibonacci spiral also known as the golden spiral. It is a thing of mathematical beauty. These skins cannot compare to its magnificence! However why not grab a skin and celebrate the greatness that is monochromatic spirals!

items.title: Giant Blocks Skyblock
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: The blocks decided to make funny faces and chill up your adventures in that sky world with lots of explorable places!

items.title: Music Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Step into the shoes of a music superstar and take to stage in your genre of choice! Become a rap legend, a metal riff-smasher, and much more with these skins in the style of 5 musical genres!

- 15 music skins to choose from across 5 genres
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Lothiredon.

items.title: Tropical Island
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
After a long trip, you manage to find a large piece of land in the middle of the ocean.
Prepare for the finest tropical vibes and discover the forgotten island!

+ Explore the tropical island and start a great adventure!
+ Perfect for a refreshing holiday with your friends!

items.title: Samurai Force
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Be a force for good! Gear up in traditional samurai armor, helmets, and swords. Defend your people when you role-play as noble warriors fighting for good. Choose from lots of skins to honor ancient Japanese customs while protecting your land.

1 free skin included!
